hero.title: Design a board game with an agent that remembers the table.
hero.sub: Guide to the Board Game Design Skill (v5.0.0): install it, use the six modes, and keep Locked decisions in project files.

items.title: Locked decisions disappear
items.body: The next session starts from scratch and reopens choices you already recorded in design-state.

items.title: Mechanism dump
items.body: Ask for worker placement and get rules in chat with no concept-brief, skeleton, or project folder.

items.title: Unfalsifiable fixes
items.body: Play feels dull, so three rules change at once. You cannot tell which variable mattered.

loop.title: Core loop
loop.note: Update design-state.md and repeat. Sims answer system questions; they do not prove fun.

items.name: Create
items.blurb: Genre profile, brief, design-state, mechanism skeleton.

items.name: Diagnose
items.blurb: Symptom routing (BG* / ED*) before rule changes.

items.name: Simulate
items.blurb: Win rate, length, dominance. Not fun validation.

items.name: Balance
items.blurb: Effective Value Range with confidence notes.

items.name: Prototype
items.blurb: Usually P4 paper PnP plus lint/checklist.

promo.title: Read the tutorial first
promo.body: It covers modes, workflow milestones, symptom routing, sample prompts, and the kill gate. Install the Skill, then point it at your game folder.
